admission.A: At least one role: candidate certified, P not; or both certified and candidate complete observed time <=0.90 P. Other role candidate certified, or both P/candidate censored with candidate own U <=1.01 P and absolute complete-cover gap <=1.25 P.
admission.B: C2 own U <=0.99 P and complete-cover absolute gap <=0.80 P, with a better independently verified real fleet. F2 own U <=1.01 P and gap <=1.05 P. If F2 P certified, candidate must certify; both certified pass F2 without zero-gap ratios.
admission.tolerance: All improvements exceed original certificate/objective tolerances; contradictory bounds are ERROR, no clipping.
admission.ENS_tradeoff: Disclose ENS certification/time loss. A/B authorize only the sealed confirmation, not algorithm admission.
admission.reject: C2 remaining near0.37-0.39 versus P near0.20 does not authorize confirmation merely because F2 certification returns.

retention: All generated inputs kept; no feedback-based redraw; started matched groups completed even if negative.
cancellation: Complete started three-arm groups. Cancel only wholly unstarted groups with a documented negative development/confirmation result. Any canceled/incomplete group precludes ADVANCE.
